bandReport.notes: Items 49-84, contiguous, no gaps, no repeats. Item 49 starts whole at the top of p16 (left column); item 84 ends whole with its code options (a)-(d) at the foot of p28 right column. All seven pages are English. COLUMN CROPS: the black scan border at the bottom of each page sits below the footer and cuts no text; the midpoint split falls in the gutter on all pages checked (p20-c1 verified clean, including the List I / List II block). The whole-page images were fully legible with a clear gutter, so all pages were read from pNN.png in strict column order (all of the left column, then all of the right). Within-page column carries: item 72's options (a)-(b) are at the foot of p24 left column and (c)-(d) at the top of p24 right column; item 78's statements are at the foot of p26 left column and its question line + options at the top of p26 right column; item 82's options (a)-(b) at the foot of p28 left column and (c)-(d) at the top of p28 right column. FIDELITY: transcribed as printed, including 'Port of Call' (69), 'outside of India' (80), 'North Sudan' (66), 'Kandaria Mahadeo' (77), and item 62's stem ending 'is an example of ?'. Items 74 and 78 options print '1 and 3' / '2 and 3' without 'only', as printed. Match-list codes (58, 84) written as 'A-4, B-3, C-2, D-1'. No figure items, no defective items. CLASSIFICATION judgement calls: 50 (Green Revolution states) under Economy / Agriculture and Rural Economy with own subtopic 'Green Revolution'; 53 (Vaishya duties per Dharmashastras) under Ancient India / Vedic Period; 67 (PAHAL) under Economy / Subsidies; 57, 58, 72 (socialism, models of democracy, social justice) under Polity / Conceptual Polity.
